import numpy as np
im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')

# simple CLAHE
tiles = 8
th, tw = H//tiles, W//tiles
out = np.zeros_like(arr)
clip = 0.01
for i in range(tiles):
    for j in range(tiles):
        y0,y1 = i*th, (i+1)*th if i<tiles-1 else H

        blk = arr[y0:y1, x0:x1]
        # histogram equalization
        hist,_ = np.histogram(blk, bins=256, range=(0,1))
        cdf = hist.cumsum(); cdf = cdf/cdf[-1]

        cdf2 = hist2.cumsum(); cdf2=cdf2/cdf2[-1]
